methods.label: Pythagorean construction
methods.explanation: Since \(2^2+1^2=5\), the hypotenuse has length \(\sqrt{5}\). Drawing an arc centered at the origin to intersect the positive half of the number line gives the point representing \(\sqrt{5}\). Legs of lengths 1 and 1 give \(\sqrt{2}\), while legs of lengths 2 and 3 give \(\sqrt{13}\).
